# API / server / sessions

One line per setting: NAME — default — meaning. Code anchors and full prose:
`docs/CONFIGURATION.md`. Index: `references/configuration.md`.

- OPENAI_COMPAT_API_ENABLED — default: OFF — Mount the OpenAI-compatible `/v1` router.
- MCP_SERVE_ENABLED — default: OFF — Mount the **inbound** MCP server surface — `POST /mcp`, hand-rolled JSON-RPC-over-POST (not the `mcp` PyPI SDK), auth via the same `X-API-KEY`/JWT/x402 policy as A2A.
- SESSION_REGISTRY_BACKEND — default: memory — Active session→orchestrator map backend: `memory` (in-proc) or `sqlite` (cross-proc metadata). ⚠️ `sqlite` on BOTH units is the precondition for a WRITABLE console (`WEBVIEW_READ_ONLY=false`): with `memory` the console's own in-process age…
- API_AUTH_TOKEN — default: unset — The operator's machine-to-machine SERVICE token.
- API_RATE_LIMIT_RPM — default: 60 — API requests/minute.
- API_RATE_LIMIT_RPH — default: 1000 — API requests/hour.
- API_RATE_LIMIT_BURST — default: 10 — API burst allowance.
- CORS_ALLOW_ORIGINS — default: **Two independent consumers, two different defaults** — see note below — Comma-separated allowed CORS origins.
- WEBVIEW_DOMAIN — default: the reference deployment's public host (webview/server.py, api/auth_endpoints.py); localhost:5050 (agents/task/utils_webview.py) — **inconsistent default across call sites; set WEBVIEW_DOMAIN for your own deployment** — The public hostname this instance is served from.
- JWT_SECRET_KEY — default: unset (dev) — JWT signing secret, shared by the API auth middlewares and the WebView (`webview/owner_auth.py` issues/verifies the owner session cookie with the same secret). **Required in production** — `api/app.py` raises `RuntimeError` at startup if u…
- A2A_BASE_URL — default: the reference deployment's base URL (set this to your own public URL) — Base URL advertised in the A2A agent card.
- WEBVIEW_ACTIVITY_ENABLED — default: true — The console's global `/activity` stream (page + `/api/activity/*` + `join_activity` socket room).
- WEBVIEW_READ_ONLY — default: false — Monitoring-only console: every mutating endpoint returns 403 server-side through ONE dependency (`webgate.read_only_guard`; the auth surfaces `/owner-login` and `/api/auth/*` stay reachable so the owner can still log in to LOOK) and the ch…
- POLYROB_API_BASE — default: http://127.0.0.1:9000 — Base URL of the main task API the webview proxies to (chat delivery, queue-status, health) in the classic two-service shape.
- SESSION_TTL_SECONDS — default: 86400 — Session lifetime.
- MAX_SESSIONS_PER_USER — default: 10 — Per-user session cap.
- SESSION_RESET_MODE — default: idle (#7) — Chat session-boundary policy: `idle`/`daily`/`both`/`none`.
- SESSION_IDLE_MINUTES — default: 1440 (**720 POLYROB_LOCAL**) — Idle threshold; a chat idle longer than this starts a fresh session (when `SESSION_RESET_MODE` includes idle).
- SESSION_RESET_HOUR — default: 4 — Local hour (0-23) for the daily session roll (when mode includes daily).
- SURFACE_GC_ENABLED — default: ON when local **+** chat bus on, else OFF — Periodic GC (hourly via the autonomy runtime) of stale chat<->session bindings; horizon `max(2× idle window, 7d)`.
- UVICORN_HOST — default: 127.0.0.1 — Uvicorn bind host (read in `main.py`).
- UVICORN_PORT — default: 9000 — Uvicorn bind port (read in `main.py`).
- UVICORN_WORKERS — default: 1 — Uvicorn worker count (read in `main.py`).
- UVICORN_RELOAD — default: OFF (false) — Uvicorn auto-reload (read in `main.py`).
- UVICORN_FORWARDED_ALLOW_IPS — default: 127.0.0.1 — Which proxies `polyrob serve` trusts for `X-Forwarded-For`/`X-Forwarded-Proto`.
- ENVIRONMENT / ENV — default: development (varies by site) — Environment selector.
- LOG_LEVEL — default: INFO — Logging level.
- POLYROB_LOG_FILE — default: per entrypoint (bot.log / email.log / webview.log) — Basename of the rotating log file under `<data_home>/logs/`; overrides the per-entrypoint default.
- CHAT_TOOL_IDS — default: task — Tools loaded for the chat surface.
- CHAT_MAX_STEPS — default: 20 — Max agent steps for a chat-surface turn (`chat_once`) and for a woken re-entry into a finished session (a card wake), that run only.
- INTERACTIVE_MAX_STEPS — default: 100 — Default step budget of an interactive request: an owner chat turn on a surface (Telegram, email, the gateway), a REPL turn, `polyrob run`, the HTTP task API and A2A; also the billed ceiling.
- RUN_BUDGET_USD — default: 0 (disabled) — Session-cumulative provider-spend ceiling in USD; when > 0 the run loop halts honestly (`run_budget_exhausted`) before the next step once summed `usage_records.api_cost_usd` for the session reaches the cap.
- AUTONOMOUS_RUN_BUDGET_USD — default: 2.0 (0 = off) — Per-run provider-spend cap in USD for an autonomous (cron/goal) run.
- CHAT_SKIP_CREDIT_CHECK — default: ON (truthy) — Skip the credit check on chat-path turns.
- API_SECRET / ADMIN_TOKEN — default: unset (secret, masked) — Secret key for the legacy `AuthenticationMiddleware` on the API app (`API_SECRET` wins, `ADMIN_TOKEN` is the fallback name); unset = that middleware is not added.
- PRODUCTION — default: OFF ('true' enables) — Marks the deploy as production independent of `ENV`: a missing `JWT_SECRET_KEY` then becomes a fatal startup error instead of a dev warning.
